description: Header file for the Arctic Core Fls (Flash Driver) module, defining interfaces, constants, and types for flash memory operations in an AUTOSAR-based system.

methods.name: Fls_Init
methods.description: Initializes the Flash Driver with a given configuration.

methods.name: Fls_GetStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_GetJobResult
methods.description: Gets the result of the last flash job.

methods.name: Fls_MainFunction
methods.description: Main function to process flash driver tasks.

methods.name: Fls_Compare
methods.description: Compares flash memory content with provided data.

methods.name: Fls_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_Check
methods.description: Performs a check on flash memory base address and size.
